<target>## **B.8. SAXPY example**

```
# void
# saxpy(size_t n, const float a, const float *x, float *y)
# {
#   size_t i;
#   for (i=0; i<n; i++)
#     y[i] = a * x[i] + y[i];
# }
#
# register arguments:
#     a0      n
#     fa0     a
#     a1      x
#     a2      y
saxpy:
    vsetvli a4, a0, e32, m8, ta, ma
    vle32.v v0, (a1)
    sub a0, a0, a4
    slli a4, a4, 2
    add a1, a1, a4
    vle32.v v8, (a2)
    vfmacc.vf v8, fa0, v0
    vse32.v v8, (a2)
    add a2, a2, a4
```

```
    bnez a0, saxpy
    ret
```</target>
